replies.author: HunterIV4
replies.body:
>As I understand it US nationals also can use it.

Incorrect. I don't know why this misinformation keeps spreading. There's an [official announcement](https://www.anthropic.com/news/fable-mythos-access) from Anthropic stating that they disabled access for everyone.

I mean, it's not like it isn't obvious how to circumvent a "US only" limit. We've only had VPNs for decades.
